reference_method: Manual visual transcription of the scanned page; financial labels and figures checked against the official born-digital Vinamilk annual report.
protocol: Copy each selected manually labeled region from the original PDF page, preserving its source content; run the existing DocumentProcessor PDF upload path (PyMuPDF/Tesseract fallback), using separate page-text and numeric-table render scales, then score chunk text and reviewed table anchors.
limitations: Production-parser OCR path only. Table scoring covers seven manually reviewed financial row anchors and 14 numeric cells on one third-party Vietnamese scan; it is diagnostic and does not establish general table accuracy or safe automatic financial publication. There are no reviewed cell coordinates and no paired OCR-engine comparison. Throughput includes parser/OCR invocation but excludes application embedding and database persistence.
